judge: Claude Code subagent, Claude Opus 5.5, fresh
critique: Clipped modern openers ('You're here. Good.'), generic 'Something foul is stirring in the valley', farms, riders on the north road and town records read like stock fantasy rather than Nox's exclamatory, jokey register; the 'raids ... is growing' slip and the reminder leaking 'horn' beside a masked [Thing] also give it away.
